text_block_list.text: And in first is Mayano Top Guuuuun!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Fujiii! You were wonderful! Good job!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Members

text_block_list.text:
That was fantastic! I didn't know what to
expect
after hearing about how she's
more suited for mile
races...
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
But she was astounding, win or lose! She
tackled a
huge challenge head-on
without even flinching!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Her next race is going to be the Arima
Kinen,
right? Ooh, I can't wait to see it!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Although Фудзи Кисэки has failed to claim
victory,
the audience is full of praise for
her admirable
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Passionate applause and cheers pour
over her
from the stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wow...
text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I didn't take first, but I was
able to run
my heart out thanks to all
your support!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The curtain has closed on today's race,
but I
promise an even greater miracle
awaits you at the
next one!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Until then, farewell!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки bows politely toward the
stands, snaps
her fingers, and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Where's the smoke coming from?!

Where's Фудзи Кисэки?!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: With that, she makes her graceful exit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just wondering, but how do you feel
about taking
on the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen next?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Shortly after we return from Kyoto, Fuji
Kiseki
stops by my office and opens a
conversation with
that sudden question.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I assumed she would want to run in the
Japan Cup
and the Arima Kinen, but I
guess I was wrong.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Since the Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a
sprint, I
can't help but wonder...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Are the long-distance races getting too
difficult?

text_block_list.text:
It's not that! I mean, it's true that I'm not
great
with long-distance races, but this
has nothing to
do with that.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There are still some odds and ends I
need to
figure out, but I'll discuss
everything with you
once I'm ready,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
For now, can I please run the
Takamatsunomiya
Kinen? I'm sorry to
spring this on you, but would
it be okay?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I have so many questions... but I'm sure
she has a
plan, and I trust her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I was thinking—I want to put on an even
bigger
show in my senior year than I did
as a classic
racer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You must've seen all the articles people
have
written about my trajectory on the
Triple Crown
tour, right?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"Фудзи Кисэки is bolstered by cheers of
support as
she takes on races against her
aptitude."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"Although her agenda has yet to be
revealed,
expectations are high."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is looking forward to her next
show."
Hehe! It's kind of embarrassing
being lauded like
this.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, almost every article
out there
is filled with profuse praise for
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was able to pull off a grand finale, and
it went
even better than I planned, to be
honest!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone's looking forward to an
even
bigger miracle from me, and I can't
disappoint
them!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The praise extolling Фудзи Кисэки shows no
signs of
slowing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If anything, her charismatic speech,
miraculous
exit from the venue, and
theatrical announcement
boosted her
popularity exponentially.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Countless articles and video clips about
her are
uploaded every day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
